$schema_note: Schema (informal): { components: Component[], flows: Flow[] }. Component = { id, name, summary, category, kind, status, position:{col,row}, source? }. Flow = { id, name, summary, status, tags?, steps: Step[] }. Step = { from, to, label, note?, kind? } where kind ∈ 'request'|'response'|'internal'|'async'|'persist'|'external'. status ∈ 'active'|'partial'|'speculative'|'legacy'. Categories drive column placement; (col,row) gives a stable layout in the explorer.

components.name: HTTP / SDK client
components.summary: Any HTTP caller — curl, SDK, IDE plugin. Auth: Bearer API key (dev: sera_bootstrap_dev_123).

components.name: sera-tui
components.summary: Ratatui terminal dashboard (rust/crates/sera-tui). Talks to gateway over HTTP only.

components.name: sera-cli
components.summary: Rust CLI (rust/crates/sera-cli). Replaces legacy Go CLI; talks to gateway HTTP API.

components.name: External MCP client
components.summary: Any MCP-compliant tool (Claude Desktop, Cursor, etc.) reaching sera-mcp.

components.name: External A2A peer
components.summary: Remote A2A-protocol agent peer exchanging envelopes with sera-a2a.

components.name: Discord user
components.summary: Human chatting via a Discord channel routed through gateway-discord connector.

components.name: Inbound mail server
components.summary: External SMTP/forwarder posting MIME to /api/mail/inbound.

components.name: sera-gateway
components.summary: Main axum API server (rust/crates/sera-gateway/src/bin/sera.rs). Hosts /api/*, /admin/*, /v1/* routes.

components.name: sera-auth
components.summary: API-key / JWT / OIDC middleware. All /api/* (except /api/health) require Authorization: Bearer.

components.name: session_store + lane_queue
components.summary: Per-session lane queue, prevents concurrent turn wedge, enforces turn timeout (SERA_TURN_TIMEOUT_SECS).

components.name: kill_switch
components.summary: Admin-armable global halt (/admin/killswitch/*) — pauses lanes and kills runtimes for rollback.

components.name: signals
components.summary: Out-of-band signal push (/api/signals/push) into running turns.

components.name: discord connector
components.summary: discord.rs sidecar bridging Discord channels into session lanes (replaces legacy/tools/discord-bridge).

components.name: hitl_gateway
components.summary: HTTP surface for HITL approvals (/api/hitl/requests).

components.name: byoh_dispatch_interceptor
components.summary: Production-path BYOH dispatch interceptor (PR #1254). Selects BYOH runtime over Stdio.

components.name: openai_compat + llm_proxy
components.summary: /v1/chat/completions, /v1/messages, /v1/models passthrough for OpenAI- and Anthropic-shaped clients.

components.name: sera-runtime
components.summary: Agent worker (rust/crates/sera-runtime). Bin + lib. Hosts harness, reasoning turn, llm_client, tools.

components.name: harness
components.summary: Per-agent process manager. Spawn once, reuse for every turn. Uses NDJSON stdio transport.

components.name: turn (reasoning loop)
components.summary: turn.rs (74KB). Drives one user→assistant turn: prompt assembly, tool invocations, completion stream.

components.name: llm_client
components.summary: Provider abstraction for OpenAI, Anthropic, LM Studio. Streaming via reqwest (rustls).

components.name: tool_hooks
components.summary: Tool invocation pipeline. Pre/post hooks, HITL gating, sandbox enforcement.

components.name: context_engine + memory_assembler
components.summary: Builds the prompt context window: pinned, recent, retrieved memory, summaries.

components.name: skill_dispatch
components.summary: Resolves SkillRef (semver), loads steps from sera-skills, runs them via tool_hooks.

components.name: stdio (NDJSON)
components.summary: stdio.rs — newline-delimited JSON transport between gateway and runtime workers.

components.name: sera-hooks
components.summary: In-process hook registry + chain executor. Async-trait Hook; WasmHookAdapter planned.

components.name: sera-hitl
components.summary: HITL approval routing + escalation chains. Bridges runtime tool-hooks with operator approvals.

components.name: sera-workflow
components.summary: Workflow engine, dreaming config, cron scheduling. Driven by /api/workflow/tasks.

components.name: sera-meta
components.summary: Self-evolution: 3-tier policy, shadow sessions, evolution proposals.

components.name: sera-plugins
components.summary: gRPC plugin registry + SDK + circuit breaker (SPEC-plugins).

components.name: sera-mcp
components.summary: MCP server + client bridge (SPEC-interop §3). Wraps external MCP tools.

components.name: sera-a2a
components.summary: A2A protocol adapter, vendored types (SPEC-interop §4). Peer-to-peer agent envelopes.

components.name: sera-agui
components.summary: AG-UI streaming protocol, 17 event types (SPEC-interop §6).

components.name: sera-skills

components.name: sera-models
components.summary: ModelProvider trait + provider implementations consumed by runtime-llm-client.

components.name: sera-byoh-agent
components.summary: Reference BYOH (Bring Your Own Harness) agent binary. Talks NDJSON to the gateway.

components.name: sera-commands

components.name: sera-eval
components.summary: Evaluation harness for agents/skills (see sera-eval-design.md).

components.name: sera-db

components.name: sera-memory-hindsight

components.name: sera-secrets
components.summary: Secrets management scaffold. Resolves SERA_SECRET_* env refs in manifests.

components.name: sera-cache
components.summary: Cache layer scaffold.

components.name: sera-mail
components.summary: Mail intake + delivery, drives /api/mail/inbound → /api/workflow/mail/deliver.

components.name: sera-queue
components.summary: QueueBackend trait, LocalQueueBackend, GlobalThrottle.

components.name: sera-telemetry
components.summary: OTel tracing, AuditBackend, LaneFailureClass, Centrifugo pub/sub, legacy audit hash-chain.

components.name: sera-tools

components.name: sera-oci

components.name: hindsight (Docker)

components.name: Discord (gateway/sidecar)

components.name: legacy/web

flows.name: Chat turn (HTTP)
flows.summary: User sends a message via POST /api/chat. Gateway authenticates, queues on the session lane, forwards to a per-agent runtime over NDJSON stdio, runtime drives the reasoning loop and streams completion deltas back as SSE. Transcript persists to sera-db.

steps.label: POST /api/chat {message, agent?, stream?}
steps.note: Bearer auth header required (dev key: sera_bootstrap_dev_123). No /v1/ prefix; sessions are server-managed.

steps.label: resolve session, enqueue on lane
steps.note: Lane queue prevents concurrent turn wedge; if lane busy → 429 queued.

steps.label: spawn or reuse harness for agent
steps.note: process_manager keeps one runtime per agent and reuses it across turns.

steps.label: send_turn NDJSON: {user content blocks}
steps.note: Wrapped in tokio::time::timeout (SERA_TURN_TIMEOUT_SECS, default 120s) to avoid lane wedge.

steps.label: transcript_persist (turn rows)
steps.note: ContentBlock transcript stored for session replay.

flows.name: Cancel turn
flows.summary: Operator or client cancels an in-flight turn. Gateway flips the session's cancel flag; the active runtime aborts the turn and lane returns to idle.

steps.label: cancel_http_chat_session
steps.note: AppState marks the matching turn cancellable; lane becomes idle once aborted.

flows.name: HITL approval round-trip
flows.summary: Runtime hits a tool that requires human approval. tool_hooks pauses, sera-hitl persists a request, operator approves via /api/hitl/requests/{id}/approve, runtime resumes the tool call.

steps.label: enqueue ApprovalRequest
steps.note: Includes tool name, args summary, risk class.

steps.label: execute sandboxed tool
steps.note: Sandbox + SSRF guards from sera-tools; egress via ext-squid.

flows.name: Workflow task run
flows.summary: Client schedules a workflow task. sera-workflow persists it, scheduler activates at cron time, sera-runtime executes one or more turns, results land back in the workflow store.

flows.name: BYOH agent dispatch (production path)
flows.summary: Bring Your Own Harness: gateway detects BYOH agent in the chat request and routes the turn to sera-byoh-agent over Stdio instead of the default runtime. Lands via sera-plcv PR #1252 (probe) and #1254 (interceptor).

steps.label: spawn / select BYOH runtime over Stdio
steps.note: byoh_catalog tracks registered BYOH runtimes; Stdio transport reused.

flows.name: AG-UI event stream
flows.summary: Front-end / client opens an AG-UI SSE stream; sera-agui forwards the 17-event protocol from runtime emissions and client-side emits.

steps.label: emit AG-UI events (17 types)
steps.note: Run lifecycle, text deltas, tool calls, state, errors.

flows.name: Plugin call (gRPC)
flows.summary: Client invokes a registered plugin by id. sera-plugins dispatches via gRPC SDK with a circuit breaker; result returns to the caller. Hot-reload available via /api/plugins/hot-reload.

steps.label: gRPC out to plugin container
steps.note: Plugin processes typically run as side-car containers; SDK lives in sera-plugins.

flows.name: Evolution proposal apply
flows.summary: Self-evolution: shadow sessions in sera-meta surface candidate rule changes. Operator approves a proposal, supplies an operator key, then applies — sera-meta persists and hot-applies the policy to running runtimes.

flows.name: Mail-to-workflow
flows.summary: Inbound mail server posts MIME to /api/mail/inbound. sera-mail normalises it and hands off to sera-workflow, which triggers an agent turn carrying the email payload.

flows.name: OpenAI / Anthropic-compat passthrough
flows.summary: Existing OpenAI- or Anthropic-shaped clients can talk to SERA without code changes. /v1/chat/completions and /v1/messages translate to the internal runtime path and shape the response back.

steps.label: drive turn or proxy
steps.note: openai_compat.rs vs llm_proxy.rs split: the former drives an agent turn; the latter is a pure provider passthrough.

flows.name: A2A peer exchange
flows.summary: A remote A2A-compliant agent hands an envelope to SERA via /api/a2a/accept; sera-a2a validates and routes to the addressed local agent. Reverse direction posts to peers via /api/a2a/send.

flows.name: Skill execution
flows.summary: Runtime resolves a SkillRef (semver), loads its steps from sera-skills, and runs them through tool_hooks. Bash-style steps go through the sandbox.

steps.label: BashAstChecker / SsrfValidator
steps.note: Security primitives mandatory before sandbox dispatch.

flows.name: Memory write (episodic + semantic)
flows.summary: End of turn, context_engine decides what to persist. Local default is SQLite FTS5 via sera-memory. Enterprise/plugin paths route through sera-memory-hindsight (hindsight Docker, or pgvector on PG).

steps.label: pgvector store (enterprise tier)
steps.note: Postgres + pgvector are an enterprise upgrade, not a local hard prereq.

flows.name: Kill switch arm (admin)
flows.summary: Operator arms the global kill switch. Gateway pauses all session lanes and instructs runtimes to kill their current turns for rollback. Status visible via /admin/killswitch/status.

flows.name: Discord-driven chat turn
flows.summary: A Discord user posts in a channel; gateway-discord maps channel → session and drives a turn just like the HTTP chat path. Reply is posted back to the channel.

flows.name: MCP tool call
flows.summary: An external MCP-compliant client connects to sera-mcp and invokes a SERA-exposed tool. sera-mcp bridges to runtime tool_hooks; tool result is mapped back to MCP.

flows.name: Invite new user (speculative)
flows.summary: There is no concrete invite endpoint in the active Rust gateway today — production auth uses API-key bootstrap + JWT / OIDC. This flow is a sketch of what a SERA-native invite would touch, marked speculative so it doesn't get mistaken for shipped behaviour.

steps.label: mint API key + create user record

flows.name: Local dev bring-up (sera-local)
flows.summary: Ops flow, included for orientation. scripts/sera-local up brings up the docker compose stack: gateway on :3001 (bridge networking), SQLite as default backend, optional Centrifugo / hindsight off by default.

steps.label: scripts/sera-local up  →  docker compose up
steps.note: WSL2: never use network_mode: host; publish on both 0.0.0.0 and [::] for Windows 11.
